items.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023
items.q: I’m a big fan of Winston Churchill by the way. I think he was a brain. He was an incredible guy.

ctx.x: Yes. We don’t have it. We don’t have anybody within the government that represents the art in general and defend and protect and promote the art and I don’t get it. This is a country, we’re supposed to be the role model of the world in every sense, and we have to take care of that. When Winston Churchill was asked during the Second War, why are you spending so much money promoting and sending artists to the troops and all this kind of thing. And he said, “If we don’t protect that and promote that why are we…
He was. I love reading about him.
